chunks: A number of our companions, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Khalid, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Abi Nasr, from Al-Reza (peace be upon him), who said:
The carnelian negates poverty, and wearing the carnelian negates hypocrisy.

key_terms.الْعَقِيقُ: Carnelian, a red semi-precious stone often worn by Muslims

ai.seo_question: What are the spiritual benefits of wearing carnelian according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: In this hadith from Imam Al-Reza (peace be upon him), the carnelian stone (aqeeq) is presented not merely as adornment but as a spiritual instrument that actively repels poverty and hypocrisy. This reflects the Shia tradition of viewing specific physical objects as vessels for divine blessings (barakah), linking external simplicity or adornment to internal moral purity. The dual benefit underscores the holistic Islamic view where material means can facilitate spiritual elevation.
